- We will reserve a dedicated slot in our non-production pool (isolated from other customers) for your window; ops will put soft capacity hold to avoid eviction.

Asha — once Finance confirms, I will issue the promo token and share the token + usage window details, plus a small checklist for teardown/rollback in case you want to abort early.
